snippet.title: Rogue Point 1.0 | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Rogue Point 1.0 is HERE. It's time to Go Rogue!

From the creators of Black Mesa, Rogue Point is a 4-player co-op FPS where teamwork is everything. Assemble your squad for high-stakes missions where every run is different. Face evolving objectives across five expansive maps: Office, Mall, Oil Rig, Airport, and the all-new Clinic. Master a diverse arsenal with unlockable attachments and unlock powerful upgrades as difficulty scales to your performance.

NEW in 1.0:
🏥 Clinic, a brand new map
💀 New 5-Star Mercenary enemy
🔫 New weapons
🎭 New cosmetics
🛠️ Modkit for community map making
✨ And more!

Plan. Adapt. Overcome. Your squad's survival depends on it.

🎮 Get Rogue Point on Steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1843840/Rogue_Point/


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
🟣 Follow Team17 on socials to stay up to date 🟣
Twitter - https://twitter.com/Team17
TikTok - https://www.tiktok.com/@team17ltd
Facebook - https://www.facebook.com/Team17/
Twitch - https://twitch.tv/Team17

*About Team17:*
Founded in 1990, Team17 is a leading developer, video games label, and creative partner for developers around the world. Team17’s portfolio of multi-award-winning and award-nominated in-house brands include Hell Let Loose, Golf With Your Friends, The Escapists, and the iconic Worms franchise, alongside its games label partner titles, including the award-winning games Blasphemous, DREDGE and Overcooked! franchise. Visit https://www.team17.com/ for more information.
